provenance_warning: The lower and upper conflict-coverage thresholds were selected after inspecting gains and regressions on the current development claims. These claims cannot confirm the rule.

backbone.primary_internal_centered: Use the three-call full-claim answerability fallback by default.
backbone.secondary_extension: The already selected leave-original-out corroboration candidate may be used as the default for a higher-accuracy secondary variant.

activation.endpoint_scope: RAG and three-call full-claim closed-book majority disagree.
activation.question_signal: Two same-model closed-book replays of each exact RAG question are semantically stable and contradict that question's RAG answer.
activation.localized_corroborated_gate: At least two eligible contradictory questions and no more than one contradictory question per three stable internal questions.
activation.causal_gate: After globally removing the selected suspect document identities from the existing context without retrieval or backfill, the rerun verdict differs from original RAG.
activation.action: Use the fixed-context rerun verdict; otherwise retain the configured backbone prediction.

confirmation_requirements: Freeze the current prompts, two replay seeds, semantic comparator, document-removal semantics, and thresholds.
Evaluate once on claims unused by all method construction in this repository.
Report the full-claim answerability backbone and leave-original-out corroboration backbone separately.
Require positive net gains for at least two victim models and no clean regression beyond one claim per victim.
Cluster uncertainty by claim and do not count the same claim at multiple rates as independent evidence.
